observations: Cloud admission forwards send_task_message, but its actual handler throws Unsupported control request subtype; live rejection matches
Cloud handleInterrupt emits its own still_queued/cancelled response and forwards the interrupt; this is not the answering worker's v1 receipt

Cloud handleCancelRequest delegates to outbound.cancelForward; print-side control_cancel_request aborts only a matching in-flight request

start_shell_task_v1 can be advertised while the host-originated cloud admission switch rejects start_shell_task

confirmed_bug.failure: A next message starts transport processing before the previous turn's result is emitted. Receipt/time gating alone therefore accepts an unrelated result and returns before the requested task begins.
confirmed_bug.live_before_fix: protocol-queue-streamed returned a successful result with no requested task_started event; isolated task-only premise passed. Final fixed run reproduces the race with explicit message owners.
confirmed_bug.live_after_fix: Final run task message 03dcb150-bdaf-418c-a23e-8e9896dfe277 received PROCESSING before preceding LATER result 50e39788-4149-4a8c-a9d8-b4e40cc4aee2. Collector retained that frame but skipped it and returned own result 77667108-caac-4b51-9dd1-455792c30f2a after actual Bash task creation.
confirmed_bug.fix: When result user_message_uuid/user_message_uuids fields are present, require exact collected-message membership in addition to the existing processing/time gate. Results without these fields retain the legacy gate. Explicit message_uuid=None now generates and forwards the correlation UUID before send.
confirmed_bug.regression: Three single/folded/list UUID cases failed before the fix and pass after it; explicit None generation and typed live-control rejection also pass

capabilities.limitation: Held-question next/later ordering only, not priority now, all in-flight races, or bridge parity
